# Kyran Jamie

> Personal website of Kyran Jamie, a software engineer who makes complicated digital products feel simple.

Kyran focuses on accessible interfaces, fast applications, useful data visualisation, and maintainable code. His selected work includes Leather, Blockport, GoldRepublic, and Usabilla.

## Site content

- [Home page](https://kyranjamie.com/index.html.md): A concise Markdown version of Kyran's profile, selected work, and professional links.
